title: Norwegian Pineapple Stir Fry
description: A sweet and savory gluten-free stir fry with a Norwegian twist.

ingredients.name: Protein of your choice (chicken, beef or tofu)

instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add protein of your choice and cook to safe internal temperature.
Add pineapple, dense stir-fry sauce, Norwegian brown sugar, and tangy soy sauce to the skillet.
Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until pineapple is caramelized.
Add fry spices to taste and stir-fry for another minute.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve over rice or noodles.
Adjust seasoning to taste and serve hot.
Let stir-fry rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Leftovers can be refrigerated for up to 3 days or frozen for up to 2 months.
